summary.headline: Hephaestion’s Katarchic Topics
summary.text: Catalog entries from a Florentine manuscript for Hephaestion’s katarchic astrology, covering inquiries, universal katarchai, founding cities and buildings, marriage and separations, abortion and childbirth, agriculture, wells and pits, buying goods, and purchasing or building ships, with folio references and cross-references to Hephaestion, book III, chapters 4–17.
